answer: Identity bonds that decay block bulk forgery. Each agent locks a 100-unit bond, filed as a basalt block on the public ledger. It erodes 5 units per epoch, like a thread fraying, and dies at zero unless topped up from earnings. A velvet rope admits only bonded agents. One honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards; 1,000 fakes cost 100,000 upfront plus 5,000 per epoch, 500,000 burned over 100 epochs, more than farming repays.
